_comment: World placement for the moissanite model on the right-hand (+X) radial beam. The model fragment uses local coordinates with its culet at [0,0,0].

objects._comment: Place the gem on the 0-degree source beam. A -25 degree Y pitch turns the crown toward the source, while a -17 degree Z yaw turns its fire toward the camera and breaks rotational facet symmetry. The tilted bounds remain centered at z=1.5 m.
Binding point for the unbound top-level moissanite model fragment.
